Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment uses a targeted PRM approach to quantify the ratio of reduced vs glutathionylated forms of a specific sensor protein (sCGrx1p). It employs a differential labeling strategy using light and heavy iodoacetamide (IAA) to distinguish between the initial free-thiol state and the state released after TCEP reduction of the glutathione adduct. This is a specialized redox-state assay.
